title: HBC single-cell RNA-seq validation workflow
summary: A reproducible BioLang analysis of 29,629 public HBC PBMC cells with an isolated Seurat 5.5.1 black-box comparison.

validation.dataset: 29,629 filtered control and stimulated PBMC cells
validation.method: Fresh BioLang CPU/GPU and GPL SCTransform process-boundary runs compared with a hash-pinned Seurat 5.5.1 oracle.
validation.limitations: Native clustering is not exact Seurat parity: ARI 0.69627 and broad PBMC identity agreement 94.92%.
